issue.title: Highlight the bead note @path attachment grammar in sase-nvim

task_type_fields.proposal: In sase-nvim, highlight @<path>, quoted @"...", @@ escapes, and @attachment:<name> tokens in bead note buffers. Follow the sase-core grammar (boundary rules, path-shaped rule, literal zones), ideally through the existing LSP or scanner tokens rather than a divergent regex.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1ck did not touch the sase-nvim plugin, a separate linked repo. Editor highlighting is a new surface.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1ck.10 (ga phase of epic sase-1ck) proposed this follow-up, and the epic plan listed it as one. Editors show @path references and @attachment tokens as plain text.
